changes.why: v0.2.4 deleted R.merge (concat, its alias, remains)
v0.2.4 keeps the first occurrence (push unless already in result) instead of the last: uniq([1, 2, 1, 3, 2]) went from [1, 3, 2] to [1, 2, 3]
v0.2.4 keeps the first representative and tests pred(item, kept): uniqWith(mod3, [1, 2, 3, 4]) went from [2, 3, 4] to [1, 2, 3]
v0.2.4's _slice no longer reads an end index of 0 as the end: a failing first element gives [] (was the whole list)
v0.2.4's _slice fix: a cut at index 0 is empty, so remove(0, 2, [1..5]) went from [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 3, 4, 5] to [3, 4, 5]
v0.2.4's _slice fix: insert.all at index 0 no longer copies the whole list first
knock-on of uniq: compose(uniq, concat) keeps first occurrences (union([1, 2, 3], [1]) went from [2, 3, 1] to [1, 2, 3])
knock-on of uniqWith: unionWith(mod3, [1, 2], [4]) went from [2, 4] to [1, 2]
knock-on of uniq: difference([1, 2, 1, 3], []) went from [2, 1, 3] to [1, 2, 3]
knock-on of uniqWith: differenceWith(par, [1, 2, 3], [4]) went from [3] to [1]
knock-on of uniq: intersection([1, 2], [3, 1, 2, 1]) went from [2, 1] to [1, 2]
knock-on of uniqWith: intersectionWith(par, [1, 2, 3], [4, 5]) went from [2, 3] to [1, 2]
v0.2.4 removed merge, which concat aliased; the revealed body is now list1 + list2, same results
